content: All autonomous tasks processed by the skill follow a fixed 5-step closed-loop reusable workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions for new, repeated, or failed tasks) → 2) Retrieve (find optimal solutions from available knowledge sources) → 3) Decide (select action path based on historical metrics) → 4) Execute (create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts, or delegate subtasks) → 5) Review (record execution results and update the knowledge base to improve future performance).
